title.en: Geometric measurement in declared model coordinates and units

summary: Measure chosen geometry in a declared metric frame while camera and explanatory display transforms stay separate.
objective: Measure a known model-space segment, move the camera and change display scale, and keep its labeled physical distance unchanged.
intent_signals: Measure a known model-space segment, move the camera and change display scale, and keep its labeled physical distance unchanged.
example_prompts: Measure a known model-space segment, move the camera and change display scale, and keep its labeled physical distance unchanged.

principles: Choose the quantity before placing a ruler: straight-line distance, surface path, projected distance and clearance are different tasks. Label the selected method and unit.
Keep endpoints in the declared metric model frame. Pixel length is a screen annotation and must not be presented as physical size without an explicit calibration model.
implementation: Import origin, axis orientation, scale and units with the geometry. Convert picked display positions back through presentation transforms, then into the declared metric frame before computing distance; reject unavailable or singular mappings.

Store endpoint attachment IDs and local coordinates, or source coordinates for fixed probes. State whether a measurement follows deformation or freezes its original source snapshot; invalidate detached endpoints on data replacement.
Expose snap type, endpoint coordinates and uncertainty/precision appropriate to the source. For voxel data include spacing and orientation; do not assume one index step equals one millimeter.

Convert numerical values and labels together when switching units. Use an independent overlay for readable text; moving label anchors must not modify measurement endpoints. Provide undo-last-point and clear-measurement actions.
observable_checks: Use a 3-4-5 segment in a metric frame: report 5 declared units. Orbit, zoom, resize and apply an explanatory display offset; the stored metric result stays 5.
Import anisotropic axis spacing and a rotated frame; verify two known landmarks by the documented affine transform, not by pixel distance.
Switch meters to millimeters for a 0.125 m segment: display 125 mm. Delete an endpoint attachment and show invalid measurement instead of retaining a plausible old number.

known_limits: This is a measurement interaction contract, not calibrated metrology. Nonlinear deformation, geodesics, CRS distances and clinical measurements need domain-specific algorithms and validation.
Draft authored guidance; no renderer, interaction artifact or scientific result was executed for this record.
creative_affordances: Choose layout and visual emphasis to support the stated inspection task; these are design proposals rather than proven usability improvements.

claims.statement: Slicer documents image-index to anatomical coordinates as an affine map: the linear part carries directions and axis scaling, while translation locates the first voxel.
claims.scope: Coordinate mapping for image data; the reusable ruler interaction and other geometry metrics are authored.
